hook.text: 'Sunflower' is a flower that faces the sun. Two words merged into one clear image.

buildup.text: Compounding joins two free morphemes into a new word with its own meaning.

discovery.text: The head of the compound usually determines the category—'sunflower' is a type of flower.

twist.text: Not all compounds are transparent: a 'deadline' has nothing to do with death or lines anymore.

climax.text: German is famous for long compounds: 'Rindfleischetikettierungsgesetz' is one legal term.

punchline.text: Stick two words together and a new idea blooms.

quiz.question: What is the head of a compound?
options: The part that determines the word's category
